correctness.rationale: The concept family is the distinct translates of one fixed subset of a finite abelian group, not the union of all coset families. For a pair with difference d, traces 11 and 00 require d in A-A and in B-B, respectively; both mixed traces occur exactly when translation by d fails to stabilize A, because the two directed set differences have equal size. There are |G| ordered pairs per qualifying nonzero d; divide by two even when d has order two, since each unordered pair still corresponds to two distinct ordered pairs. Quotienting by the stabilizer preserves traces across distinct fibers while a pair within a fiber cannot be shattered. In the quotient every nonzero d has both mixed traces; the larger of the two parts has the entire difference set if its size is greater than half, and at equality the two overlap counts agree for every d. Thus if the other part has two distinct points there is a shattered pair. A singleton part pulls back to a coset or its complement, and coset partitions and their Boolean complements realize no shattered pair. Each coset determines its subgroup, and a coset can equal another subgroup's coset complement only in the index-two case, with the same subgroup; exactly two subsets are then counted twice. This proves the census and the cyclic divisor specialization. Least positive period n means trivial stabilizer; singleton and co-singleton sets give 2n distinct words for n>=3, coincide as classes at n=2 (two words), and both constant words count at n=1. Counting indexed words, not necklaces, is essential. Separate direct trace and census checks passed for all 8190 cyclic subsets through order twelve and the three abelian groups of order eight (counts 28, 48, 88). evidence: For a cyclic seed replace it by its smaller side (complementation preserves shift-VC). On two ordered coordinates i<j, if the all-substrings family shatters them, traces 11 and 01 must already arise from full windows, since a shorter string omitting j cannot have a 1 there. Equal window marginals give 10 whenever 01 occurs. The number of 00 windows is the number of 11 windows plus n minus twice the smaller-side size, so 00 also occurs. Thus for a sparse periodic seed Johnson's all-substrings dimension is at most one exactly when shift-VC is at most one. Lemma 9 forces a nonconstant such periodic sequence to have one 1 per least period. Complementing back gives the cyclic classification, from which the two cyclic counts follow by counting periods and offsets.

The same reduction does not turn a general noncyclic abelian group with an arbitrary seed into the orbit of one cyclic shift, nor does Johnson give the number of shattered pairs for arbitrary group seeds.

value.rationale: VC dimension one is the first nonconstant level, and giving its exact group-theoretic structure rather than approximate regularity is a natural complete classification. The general subgroup census distinguishes groups of the same order (e.g., 28, 48, and 88 qualifying subsets in the three abelian groups of order eight), and the exact pair statistic quantifies departures from the classification for every seed using differences and periods. This value does not rely on treating the cyclic specialization or divisor-sum inversion as a separate discovery.
